# Wallpaper provenance

Two groups. Nothing ships from this folder without a line in this file.

## Generated by CrossPlay (CC0)

Every geometric, op-art, halftone, contour and dithered piece here is generated
procedurally by the scripts in `tools_local/wallpapers/` with fixed seeds, so it
is reproducible and original. Released as CC0; no third party, no attribution
owed.

    bauhaus  bulge  checker  cubes  halftone  hatch  herringbone  houndstooth
    orb  penrose  rings  sunburst  topography  truchet  vortex  waves

## Sourced (The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Open Access, CC0)

Each was fetched from the Met Open Access API with `isPublicDomain == true` and
is released by the museum under CC0. All are woodcut, engraving or etching, i.e.
native line art. Tonal and photographic reproductions (mezzotint, aquatint,
stipple) were rejected on purpose: 1 bit has no midtones, so they dither into a
grainy field. Each was cropped to the artwork -- no page margin, plate mark or
letterpress caption -- and filled to 480x800 rather than letterboxed.

### owl.bmp
- **Title:** Monedula, Chouëtte (The Owl), from "Livre d'Oyseaux" (Book of Birds)
- **Artist:** Albert Flamen
- **Date:** 1655-60
- **Medium:** Etching
- **Accession:** 2011.467.12 (Met object 751141)
- **Source:** https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/751141
- **Image:** https://images.metmuseum.org/CRDImages/dp/original/DP857003.jpg
- **Licence:** CC0 (Public Domain), The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Open Access
- **Conversion:** Letterpress caption, signature line and border rule removed; paper tone remapped to white before thresholding.

### dragonflies.bmp
- **Title:** Dragonflies and a bumble bee
- **Artist:** Wenceslaus Hollar
- **Date:** 1646
- **Medium:** Etching; first state of three
- **Accession:** 26.72.119 (Met object 361546)
- **Source:** https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/361546
- **Image:** https://images.metmuseum.org/CRDImages/dp/original/DP823961.jpg
- **Licence:** CC0 (Public Domain), The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Open Access
- **Conversion:** The right-hand pair (damselfly above, dragonfly below) taken from a landscape sheet, cropped inside the plate mark to fill the panel. Hollar's own etched inscription is kept: it is cut into the plate by the artist, not letterpress on the sheet.

### celestial.bmp
- **Title:** The Celestial Map - Northern Hemisphere
- **Artist:** Albrecht Dürer
- **Date:** 1515
- **Medium:** Woodcut
- **Accession:** 51.537.1 (Met object 358366)
- **Source:** https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/358366
- **Image:** https://images.metmuseum.org/CRDImages/dp/original/DP102235.jpg
- **Licence:** CC0 (Public Domain), The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Open Access
- **Conversion:** Letterpress title band, border rule and the four corner astronomer portraits removed.
